_comment: Every evidence phrase in shared/schools-rshe-2026.ts was run against the live
schools.school_lessons rows in production on the date below, as a case
insensitive substring test scoped to that requirement's own modules. This file
records the result and a hash of what was tested.
scripts/check-rshe-coverage.mjs recomputes the hash from the data module. If
anyone adds a phrase, changes a module list or edits a requirement without
re-running the production check, the hash moves and CI fails. That is the point:
a coverage claim cannot be edited into existence.
Regenerate with: npm run rshe-evidence (prints the SQL to run against production).
source: production schools.school_lessons, after migrations 309 to 316, with 312 to 315 carried in hash verified chunks and proved by their own migration history entries
